home.heroTitle: Carved from the olive trees of the Holy Land
home.heroText: Nativity sets, crosses, rosaries and pieces for the home, each one shaped by hand from olive wood.
home.heroAlt: Olive wood nativity stable and cross beside an olive branch
home.value1Text: Every piece is cut, carved and polished by hand, so no two are exactly alike.
home.value2Text: The wood comes from pruned branches of olive trees, a tree that lives for centuries.
home.value3Text: Olive wood is dense and hard-wearing, with a warm grain that deepens over the years.
home.storyTitle: A craft passed down through generations
home.storyText: Olive wood carving has been practised in and around Bethlehem for centuries. We work with carvers who keep that tradition alive.

about.title: Our story
about.intro: Gethsemane is named after the olive garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem.
about.p1: Olive trees can live for many centuries. When the trees are pruned, the cut branches are dried slowly and given to carvers, so no tree is felled for this wood.
about.p2: Each piece is cut, carved, sanded and polished by hand. The grain of olive wood is different in every branch, which is why every piece in our shop is unique.
about.p3: We want to share this craft with homes around the world and support the families who practise it.
